name: game-review-test-kit
purpose: Tests for the static chess game reviewer (Stockfish in Web Workers, win%/accuracy grading, coach text, storage). Runs without the real Stockfish or chess.js.

env.PROJECT_ROOT: path of the app (folder with index.html and js/). Default: parent of the kit, cwd, siblings.
env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH: path of the playwright package (browser suites and playground only)
env.CHROME_PATH: Chrome/Chromium binary (browser suites and playground only)
env.KIT_SITE: directory of the built test site (default build/site)
env.KIT_BUILD: directory for reports, artifacts and the built site (default build/)

commands.verify: run what your changes can affect; everything on the first run or with --all. Writes build/last-green.json when green
commands.run [suite..]: static perft chess kit unit fuzz snapshot workflow e2e; flags --only <regex> --tag <t> --seed N --fast --workers N --retries N --bail --strict --budget-ms N
commands.list [--suite s]: every test id, tags and covered project files (build/index.json)
commands.explain <id>: source snippet, files, last failure and rerun command of one test
commands.affected [files..]: tests touched by changed files (default: changed since last green)
commands.fuzz [--seed N]: chess + fuzz suites with a printed seed
commands.mutate [--max N] [--deep]: mutation testing: breaks the app's code on purpose and checks the tests notice
commands.book: rebuild data/mock-book.json after editing src/chess-core.js or src/mock-engine.js
commands.selftest: prove the kit notices broken Stockfish builds
commands.engine: check a real Stockfish binary: node engine-check.mjs --bin <path>

output: JSON on one line when stdout is not a terminal (or --json), human text with --human

files.build/report.json: full machine-readable report (schema 1): summary, suites, failures[{id,detail,hint,covers,artifacts,rerun,explain}], flaky, warnings, knownBugs, slowest
files.build/artifacts/<suite>__<test>/: failure.txt, screenshots of failed browser tests
